description.en: The HDMI Type A plug interface: a 19-contact shell 13.90 × 4.45 mm with two chamfered corners on one long side, mating a Type A receptacle one way up.
description.es: La interfaz de la clavija HDMI Tipo A: una carcasa de 19 contactos de 13.90 × 4.45 mm con dos esquinas achaflanadas en un lado largo, que acopla con un receptáculo Tipo A en una sola posición.
description.fr: L'interface de la fiche HDMI Type A : un blindage à 19 contacts de 13,90 × 4,45 mm avec deux coins chanfreinés sur un grand côté, qui s'accouple à une embase Type A dans un seul sens.
description.pt: A interface da ficha HDMI Tipo A: uma blindagem de 19 contatos de 13,90 × 4,45 mm com dois cantos chanfrados num lado longo, que acopla num receptáculo Tipo A num só sentido.

sources.title: CUI Devices HD03-19-P-FR HDMI plug datasheet, rev 1.01 (2022-08-05; discontinued part)
sources.supports: 19 contacts; plug shell outside 13.90 × 4.45, +0.04/−0.05; insertion force 44.1 N max

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the overmold's front face, on the shell axis. +z runs along the shell toward its tip (the shell's length is not cited); +x runs along the shell's width; +y = z × x points from the long side with the two chamfered corners toward the plain long side. The overmold and cable lie at z < 0.

interfaces.note: Male: the shell goes into a Type A receptacle, plain side to plain side. A mate seats the overmold face on the receptacle's front face, a convention. The x_axis is −x so that a mate (a half-turn about the frame's x, ASM-1 §3.4) puts the plug's +y side on the receptacle's +y side.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: One maker's plug drawing, for a part since discontinued; a current plug drawing from a second maker would strengthen it. The shell's length and the overmold are not stated (the drawing's 10.25 runs to a rib, not to a stated insertion depth), so there is no envelope.
